versions.changelog: Quickstart command auto-detects and imports browser bookmarks in one shot. Setup now shows available browsers. Better GUI empty states.
Docs: global examples, no regional references
v4.2.1: Documentation rewrite. Professional, human-written docs.
v4.2.0: Interactive GUI console with search, tag cloud, knowledge graph, reading timeline, collections, review queue. Dark/light mode. Zero dependencies.
Added feedback command (plain, --bug, --idea) with GitHub issue URL generation. Added debug command for system info. Added What's New message on first run after upgrade. Bumped version to 4.1.0.

v4.0.1: improved auto-save summaries (no title duplication, better tag extraction), all v4 features tested end-to-end. Features: auto-save with urllib fetch + local summarization + auto-tags, interactive HTML knowledge graph, natural language search with time/source/status/rating/sort filters, collections with markdown and HTML export, spaced repetition review queue.
v4.0.0: Auto-save (fetch, summarize, tag with zero LLM), interactive knowledge graph, natural language search, collections/reading lists, spaced repetition review queue
v3.0.0: Streaks and milestones, insights command, related links, auto-tag suggestions, gems, random, weekly summaries, better help and error messages, ANSI colors

- Major update: Adds automated tests and refines import instructions.
- Added fixture files and a test script for imports from YouTube, Reddit, Pocket, Instapaper, Raindrop.io, and Hacker News.
- SKILL.md restructured for brevity, clarity, and quick start guidance.
- Import instructions for major platforms now more prominent and easier to follow.
- Browser and platform import details streamlined; unnecessary repetition removed.
- No changes to core scripts—focus is on documentation and testability.

Added platform-specific import support: YouTube (Takeout), Reddit, Pocket, Instapaper, Raindrop.io, Hacker News. Use --source flag on import command for better parsing. Auto-detects platform from filename/content when --source is omitted.

Added scan/import/sync features for importing bookmarks from Chrome, Safari, Firefox, and bookmark export files (HTML, JSON, CSV). Added sources command to track where links came from. Two-way sync detects added and removed bookmarks.
v2.1: Scan bookmarks from Chrome/Safari/Firefox/X. Import from HTML/JSON/CSV export files. Two-way sync with removal detection. Source tracking per link. sources command for overview.
v2: Added digest, rate, read/unread tracking, recommend, and config support. DB migration is automatic.
Initial release. Save any URL with AI-generated summaries and tags. Full-text search with SQLite FTS5. Find anything by describing what you remember.
